issues.reason: The owning operating composite lacks the required unconditional default entry, preventing the required search scope from being entered through the root initial mechanism.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The closed model does contain a root-to-SearchMission transition and may be intended to receive Start Mission as an external stimulus, but the supplied deterministic facts explicitly classify that transition as unreachable and non-default.
issues.title: Search mission lacks unconditional root entry

issues.basis: NL2 action requirement; exact SearchMission binding; reference inspection action inventory count 0; no FCSTM action field is present for the mapped operating scope.
issues.expected: SearchMission operation continuously performs target search tasks before mission completion.
issues.observed: The closed model supplies no action carrier for target search; the action inventory is empty.
issues.reason: The exact SearchMission operating scope has no supplied action carrier for the required continuous target-search behavior. The deterministic action inventory reports zero actions, so the required state_action remains unsupported at the closed carrier.
issues.requirement_quote: Before the mission is completed, the UAV swarm continuously performs target search tasks, during which it operates within three different state areas.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source phrase could describe an informal behavioral intent rather than a typed state action, but the contract explicitly retains it as a state_action obligation and no action carrier is supplied.
issues.title: Target search action is absent

issues.basis: NL3 transition requirement; exact FormationAdjust target binding; ambiguous current-state source; closed carrier transition line 57 from SearchMission to FormationAdjust; no single exact source state is specified by NL3.
issues.expected: On interception, the current UAV swarm operating state transitions to FormationAdjust.
issues.observed: The closed model provides only an owner-level SearchMission-to-FormationAdjust carrier, while the required current-state source is not uniquely identified.
issues.reason: The target FormationAdjust binds exactly, but the contract's source is the unresolved phrase "current state." The closed model has an owner-level SearchMission-to-FormationAdjust transition without an exact source-state interpretation for the quantified current-state requirement.
issues.requirement_quote: When the UAV swarm is intercepted, it transitions to the formation adjustment state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The author source itself places the interception edge on SearchMission, so SearchMission may be the intended semantic current-state scope; this prevents a precise endpoint verdict without a unique NL source binding.
issues.title: Interception transition source is not uniquely defined

issues.basis: NL4 requires entry to AttackState on Task Assignment Received; source transition tr_0012 carries that event; closed transition line 59 reaches AttackState but has an empty trigger set and guard R45RouteToken == 12.
issues.expected: The SearchMission operating scope enters AttackState when Task Assignment Received occurs.
issues.observed: Transition line 59 reaches AttackState but its trigger set is empty; Task_Assignment_Received is consumed only by lower-level or synthetic-route transitions, not by the owner-level endpoint carrier.
issues.reason: The exact SearchMission-to-AttackState endpoint exists, but the closed carrier has no trigger. The required event is present in the model as a declaration and consumers, yet the endpoint transition is guarded by route-token data rather than carrying the required event trigger.
issues.requirement_quote: During flight, if task assignment information is received, it enters the attack state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The compiler may intentionally encode the event through route-token effects and guards, but the supplied closed transition fact does not establish that event-to-carrier equivalence.
issues.title: Task-assignment trigger is not carried by the closed transition

issues.basis: NL4 derived effect obligation; attack completion source transition tr_0013; closed carrier transition line 55 effect R45RouteToken = 14; supplied variable inventory exposes only R45RouteToken and no UAV count.
issues.expected: Completing the attack decreases the number of UAVs in the swarm.
locus_names: number of UAVs in the swarm
issues.observed: The attack-finished carrier only assigns R45RouteToken = 14; no UAV-count variable decrease is supplied.
issues.reason: The attack-completion carrier exists, but its supplied effect changes only the route-control token and does not provide the required UAV-count decrease. The exact count variable and delta are not available for a frozen predicate, so the precise semantic gap remains unexpressed.
issues.requirement_quote: After completing the attack, the number of UAVs in the swarm decreases accordingly.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The phrase "accordingly" leaves the exact numeric delta open, and the route-token assignment may be compiler control data; nevertheless, no supplied effect carries a UAV-count decrease.
issues.title: UAV-count decrease is not represented
